features.note: Null/bool/int64/double/length-bearing byte strings cross the bridge; no retry/fallback. Existing selected evidence remains separate.
Input permits only a zeroed empty array; populated/flagged arrays and all array returns reject.
Only fixed-capacity class metadata buckets are built. No exported general HashTable operations, nested zval destruction or COW.
No zend_reference construction, alias graph/writeback or ref-source/type semantics; copy_value only retains strings.
Objects cannot cross the value boundary; scoped native call constructs an ephemeral own object, ignoring create_object and general object-store identity.
User destructor callbacks are rejected; not a complete destructor/free/custom-offset protocol.
No resource registry/type/destructor/persistent resource handling or managed proxy; unsupported tags reject.
Strings retain/release; arrays/objects shallow copy and are freed without general recursive/refcount semantics. Do not open new tags before this changes.
get_gc only exposes roots; no cycle collector/object store or general persistent/request heap.
One module, selected MINIT/GINIT/RINIT/RSHUTDOWN/MSHUTDOWN/GSHUTDOWN; failed startup rollback and foreign attached-thread unload need implementation.
Callback core only: synchronous owned invocation, same request/thread, abort captured locally; arbitrary native callables/async/lifecycle callbacks absent.
std::string is returned via c_str with no length; embedded-NUL suffix is inaccessible at existing API.
Existing output lacks module/INI headings; table_end itself also differs from pinned text-mode contract.

approval_scope: Independent native state/value/bridge work under approved option A; no source adoption, new dependencies or option B implementation performed
